Everyone of my finds so far has been completely unexpected. I'll be honest and say I do try to get the delivery schedules and info like that so I can go early in the morning and get some boxes but every time I am told a day, I show up and they say we don't have a delivery today, so I just gave up on that. What I do is ask the employees if they have any more in the back, sometimes they do and sometimes they don't. Overall it's a hit and miss game to me at least.

I mean you could watch YouTube videos and see all these dudes raid pallet after pallet after dump bin and get 10, 15, or even 30 supers a week but all that's going to do is piss you off.

My best advice for you is just take it easy, don't look for supers, let them find you. 5 of my 9 wild finds were when I was just looking for another mainline and happened to run into a super.

Another thing I've begun to do is just buy them from eBay. Now let me explain why...

First off I own a Dodge Charger R/T with a V8 and the thing gets 15 miles to the gallon when I drive like an old lady (which I rarely do 😂) so after a day of hunting, hitting about 10 or 15 stores I'll be needing gas so that's another 30 or 40 dollars wasted plus the miles I put on the car plus the time I wasted looking for a super.

My second car is a Chevy Silverado with a V6, and you'd expect this thing to get better gas mileage but it doesn't. 14 miles to the gallon 😂. So if I take this around for a day it eats 50 to 60 dollars in gas!

So instead of spending that much money and wasting that much time I'd rather just buy it from eBay for $20 and get it within a few days.

$20 is the maximum I'll ever spend on a super, even the Batmobile.

So my best advice is stop looking for supers, not only is it going to make you go crazy but you'll lose WAY more than you'll ever gain.

Happy hunting!

Hello!

Id like to start of by saying thank you for doing this! I was just going to post my own give away tomorrow.

Ok so let me start at the beginning. When i was a child, i had an obsession for ANY kind of vehicle, rather it be a car, truck, semi, jet, bus, or even a toaster on wheels, I JUST NEEDED IT! one of my earliest memories is from my days in kindergarten. We had a 100 day of school show and tell project. Students were required to bring in 100 of something...... guess what i chose? Thats right 100 diffrent Hot Wheels! Imagine a short, fat, 5 year old walking into school with 5 bags full of hot wheels 😂  and from there it just got better! I dont remember much but by the time i was 14 i had lost interest in toys..... well actually i wouldnt say "lost interest", it was more like financial issues. In all honesty my parents had just bought a house, my mom started going back to school to become a nurse, and my dad had opened his first store (which at the time wasnt doing well) so i had to put my hobbies and interest to the side for a bit, plus i already had around 4 or 5 hundred loose cars EVERYWHERE! So by 16 financially we were in a mich better place but i moved on to gaming, what mean by that is instead of playing with cars on a carpet, i started to play Forza and GTA with friends i made online. That same year my dad thought since i was "too old" for toys, he could pack them up , which i was fine with..... what he didnt tell me was he was going to mail them all to California, where my 7 year old cousin lives. So that pretty much ended my collecting.

Fast forward to March of 2015, i boughty first car at 19, 2011 Dodge Charger and she was properly named [Letty](http://i.imgur.com/bZVq4US.jpg). After getting this i was determined to find a scale model of my car, while looking online i ran into an article that said hot wheels was going to release a 2015 Dodge Challenger Hellcat. I now wanted that car no matter what 😂. So after a few weeks i finally found one on a short card, turns out it was from a 50 car case that someone had opened and dumped out, but since i had already picked up the 3 i wanted (Challenger Hellcat, BMW M3 (i think) in goldish green, and the DeLorean hover mode time machine) so they just let me have them for free! After that i didnt buy anything else till July of 2016 when i heard GreenLighy was releasing my exact car as a model! [Immediately i pre-ordered 4](http://i.imgur.com/IppsLRG.jpg) and thats where it all started! After that i would regularly pick up Mopars and other cars i liked. Around August i found this sub since i wanted to get more knowledge of what was/is out there for me to collect. And the rest is history.

Oh and the main reason i collect CARDED hot wheels is cause my mom didnt like the mess i use to make with loose ones 😂 

Ok so now for my absolute favorite hot wheel car is going to have to be the 2011 Dodge Charger $uper, not cause its a super but because the 2011 Charger was and still is my first car! This car no matter what will put a smile on my face as soon as i put my foot down and hear those tires squeal! I love the model since it reminds me of the hard work i had to go through to get to where i am and afford my car.

My favorite non-Hot Wheels car is the GreenLight Mopar 11 [Charger](http://i.imgur.com/Qgj9Umt.jpg) because it is MY CAR! This will bring up memories for the rest of my life and will always hold a special place in my collection!

TLDR: use to have tons of loose cars, dad gave them away. Lost interest till i bought my first car. After i got my car, GreenLight released an exact 1/64 scale model. Collecting started again!
